question: What’s the nearest restaurant encountered when moving from Beltzville State Park - Parking Lot B, Lehighton, PA toward Saint John Vianney Center, Downingtown, PA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.632738 40.859032)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.683505 40.012309)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.632738 40.859032)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.632738 40.859032)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: Beltzville State Park - Parking Lot B, Lehighton, PA

poi.poi_name: Beltzville State Park - Parking Lot B

[3].display_name: Saint John Vianney Center, Downingtown, PA
